verdict.rationale: Treg's docs describe request/response operations (REST, the /call/ proxy, CLI and MCP) but never mention webhook subscriptions or event delivery. An independent commenter describes Treg as a set of stateless APIs and says webhooks and signals are exactly what it lacks compared with tools like Clay or pipe0. An API gateway could plausibly offer webhooks, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence Treg delivers them.
